angleRead.name: Mason Ortega
angleRead.text: I'm planning to focus on the rhythm and grind of the Laurel kitchens, specifically Nino's and Schoolgate Cafe. The goal is to capture the essence of a single shift—what it feels like to be on the line, the interactions with regulars, the pace of the work, and the unspoken worries of the cook. Colin Phillips at Nino's and Jori Clame at Schoolgate Cafe are my primary targets. I want to understand their daily routines, the challenges they face, and what keeps them going.
